notes.title: THE MAGISTER IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[b]If you've enjoyed The Magister: The First Two Days then you'll be happy to hear the full game is now available, so you can try sleuthin' and deducin' your way through all 14 days of a complete investigation![/b]

[list]
[*] Randomly generated murder-mystery means every playthrough is different!
[*] Use physical, weapon, and magic cards to overpower enemies in battle
[*] Master 'Tactical Diplomacy' with conversation cards for peaceful outcomes
[*] Variety of Magisters to play as, each with their own specialties and flaws
[*] Recruit an ally to help, including a cat or dog companion to fight alongside you 
[/list]
The Magister is available to purchase and download now from the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304770/The_Magister/]store page[/url][/b], and you can grab it with a 15% launch discount for a limited time. You can also pick it up on Nintendo Switch, and it'll arrive tomorrow (3rd Sept) on Xbox One.

[previewyoutube=JqCM-C5IbZg;full][/previewyoutube]
Good luck in your quest to unmask the guilty culprit! If you enjoy The Magister, please consider leaving a review to let other folks know – every review helps! Thanks for the support! 

Matt | Digerati

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304770/The_Magister/

notes.title: YOU CAN PLAY THE FIRST TWO DAYS OF THE MAGISTER RIGHT NOW!
notes.content:
If you want to sample murder-mystery card-battler The Magister ahead of its launch on 2nd September, you can do that right now courtesy of The Magister – The First Two Days, which is available to download for free here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1716720

As you can probably deduce from the title, it serves up a tasty slice of what to expect from the full game by giving you the first two days of the randomly-generated whoddunit adventure to play through (the full game takes place over 14 days). 

Hit that 'Play Now' button and enjoy!

And to be sure you don't miss when The Magister itself launches, be sure to W + F the main game below!

Matt | Digerati

[h3][b]WISHLIST AND FOLLOW![/b][/h3]
